text:
Maria P.: Heads-up — we need to reset P0 milestone scope. Customer X just reprioritized security audit + must have privacy logging. Timeline slipped by ~2 weeks. Proposing we cut: non-essential webhook connectors, advanced analytics dashboard, ML cost optimizer (v1). Need quick alignment for Friday launch window.

Devon K.: Agree on cut list. Can we keep basic analytics read-only? That's low effort.

Anna S.: +1. Suggest we also defer 'bulk dataset export' — large infra risk.

Leo W.: Risk callout: removing webhook connectors reduces integration testing surface but saves ~3 sprint-weeks. Still need to preserve "retry/backoff" infra for core ingestion.

Jin (ENG): Rough effort estimates: webhook connectors (5d), advanced dashboard (10d), cost optimizer (8d), bulk export (6d). If we cut dashboard + cost optimizer we free ~18d — gets us back to Friday.

Maria P.: OK — proposed MVP cuts (final):
```
- remove: advanced analytics dashboard (defer v1)
- remove: cost optimizer (defer to v1)
- remove: bulk dataset export
- keep: basic analytics read-only
- keep: retry/backoff and logging
```

Devon K.: Any customer regressions? Customer X needs privacy logs — that's staying yes?

Maria P.: Yes, privacy logging remains. We will surface caveats to customer and offer timeline for v1 features.

Anna S.: Can ops support a mid-week patch if we find infra bugs from cutting features?

Leo W.: Ops: yes, we can do one emergency patch window Wednesday. But we need a clear rollback plan.

Jin (ENG): Rollback plan: tag release, feature flags for dashboard + cost optimizer + export. If issues, flip flags + hotfix.

pm-bot: Milestone P0 updated by @Maria P. — scope reduced; ETA still Target: 2026-02-20. See /milestones/760 for details.

Maria P.: Next steps: 1) Eng to implement flags for deferred features (Jin) 2) QA test minimal analytics + logging (Anna) 3) Customer comms draft (Devon) 4) Ops hold patch window (Leo). Agree?

Devon K.: Agree. I'll draft customer note and ping legal for wording.

Anna S.: I'll prioritize QA test plan today.

Jin (ENG): I'll add flags and post PR by EOD tomorrow.

Leo W.: Ops scheduled patch window Wed 03:00-04:00 UTC. Marked.

Maria P.: Thanks — we'll reconvene Thu 10:30 for final go/no-go. :checkered_flag:
